required_comparison.idea: Keep an exposed blocker/healer through consecutive artillery, but specify two-hit survival arithmetic, healing timing, and every other task lost while healing.
required_comparison.condition_to_beat: M75 C5 Ansel had two 891 hits 150 frames apart and only 506.8 self-heal between them.

required_comparison.idea: Use a supported retreat after a projectile locks a position, then redeploy a live replacement; verify released enemies, tile, fee, redeploy cooldown, and replacement attack/BLOCK startup.
required_comparison.known_supported_observation: M70 retreat@2054 after PROJECTILE_BORN@2053 avoided the splash and Spot deployed@2341 in a successful full plan.

required_comparison.idea: Change route contact, focus fire, or economy so artillery or another pressure source dies earlier; must identify real contact time, damage type, and which abandoned target is covered.
required_comparison.constraint: Paper DPS and total healing are insufficient; compare actual attack intervals and blocked path/contact timing.

mandatory_closure: Zero leaks, both protected targets alive and reached, all enemies settled, artillery killed, #34 killed, and continuous roadblock passage remain requirements.

constraints.artillery: Cast starts cooldown and target selection; projectile born locks position; splash hits after delay. Retreating after lock does not guarantee avoiding every future shell.
constraints.ordinary_attacks: Target at ATTACK_STRIKE; no windup lock. Replacement does not reset enemy cooldown.
constraints.death: No refund and no later skill, healing, retreat, or BLOCK.
